# Vendored cuRobo

Source: NVIDIA cuRobo as used by the supplied RoboTwin runtime.

Base commit: `b7efdaa5b7f19c6bc82a352e16689c10a5046238`.

Copied as an independent source snapshot. CUDA binaries and Git metadata are excluded;
CUDA extensions are compiled into the E05 cache for the detected GPU architecture.
Preserve LICENSE, LICENSE_ASSETS and source copyright notices.
